system.description:
You must be in [Standby]. Use this skill when you make an Evasion or Resistance check against an attack with the tags [Target: Single] and [Ranged Attack] or [Magic Attack]. In the case of successful [Dodge Check], not only will the attack fail but also damage the attacker as if they hit themselves.

A special skill that instantly repels arrows that aim at you. A flash of a samurai who has reached the secret can even cut down magic.
